verdict.rationale: Honcho publishes an API reference with autogenerated endpoint pages and interactive examples, including guidance for building integrations in unsupported languages. It also offers Python/TypeScript SDKs over documented operations such as context(), chat(), and search, plus scoped API keys for programmatic access. A public llms.txt adds an agent-readable docs entry point. missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec found at standard paths (all probed paths returned 404), no independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
